title: Compartment door never opened after an unlock pulse
description: Published on locker/{locker_uuid}/event when the door has not been observed open within the detection window following an open_compartment pulse (ADR-0031). The relay fired and the command response already reported success; the door did not move. Causes include a jam, something blocking or holding the door, a worn latch, or a failed door sensor. The detection window follows the bank's heartbeat interval.
